children.value: > Fact From Story: Used in a video by popular TikToker Tube Girl and then in countless hair-flip transition clips, the song went viral, eventually amassing over 320 million streams globally, topping charts internationally, and becoming McRae’s proper breakthrough and a rare reintroduction.
> > Fact From Story: Greedy’s the thing that’s pushed McRae to the next level

> > > Fact From Story: McRae also channelled an alter ego (Tatiana, who’s “ballsy, loud and obnoxious”) for Greedy’s vibrant music video, a fun throwback to choreographed Y2K-era aesthetics – McRae dancing all lustily on a Zamboni (so Canadian) – which surely helped.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Music videos can help songs go viral.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A song that pushes someone to the next level will go viral and top charts.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A song going viral and topping charts is an example of the song being a hit.
